seo.title: Kaspi bot for stores: automated pricing and stock | Kaspi Bot
seo.description: Kaspi Bot automates price undercutting, stock management, and order monitoring for Kaspi.kz stores. Manage all your stores in one service, with a 3-day free trial.

hero.heading:
Kaspi bot for managing your store
on {brand}
hero.description: Manage all your stores in one place — price automation, order monitoring, and sales analytics.

multiStore.subtitle: All your stores in one place
multiStore.title: Multi-store management
multiStore.text: Add all your stores to Kaspi Bot. Manage products and prices, track orders, and view combined analytics for every store in one place.

syncProducts.subtitle: Every product in every store
syncProducts.title: Product synchronization
syncProducts.text: Has Kaspi ever removed all your products from sale? Or perhaps you need to add the same products to all your stores? Instead of processing them manually, use one button to put every product back on sale and add it to your active stores.

priceBot.subtitle: Keep your stores in 1st place
priceBot.title: Automated pricing
priceBot.text: Simply set a minimum and maximum price for each product. You no longer need to watch competitors and update prices manually — the bot handles it automatically without going below your minimum.

stockManagement.subtitle: Stock levels update automatically
stockManagement.title: Stock management
stockManagement.text: Set the product quantity once, and Kaspi Bot will send it to Kaspi whenever the price changes. The setting applies to every product and eliminates manual stock updates.

telegramOrders.subtitle: Access orders without opening Kaspi Seller Cabinet
telegramOrders.title: Orders in Telegram
telegramOrders.text: Kaspi Bot automatically sends new orders to a Telegram channel. Add your employees so they can see everything needed to process an order, while prices, revenue, and store owner details remain hidden.

analytics.subtitle: Understand what customers buy and when
analytics.title: Sales analytics
analytics.text: Kaspi Bot collects order statistics and presents them in clear charts. Compare orders by month, day, and hour, find your most popular products, and identify peak buying periods.

seo.title: Automated pricing on Kaspi — price control | Kaspi Bot
seo.description: Kaspi Bot monitors competitor prices, respects your minimum and maximum price range, and tracks Kaspi's limit of 250 changes per 30 minutes. Pricing can be controlled for each product.

priceBot.subtitle: Automated price management
priceBot.title: Automated pricing on Kaspi
priceBot.screenshotAlt: Kaspi Bot automated pricing interface — screen {number}

howItWorks.title: How automated pricing works
howItWorks.text: Kaspi Bot checks external competitors and sets your price one configured step below the cheapest offer. Connected stores belonging to the same owner are excluded, so they do not undercut one another. Sellers on your ignored competitors list are excluded as well.

priceRange.title: Minimum and maximum prices
priceRange.text: You set a minimum and maximum price range for each product. The bot never lowers the price below the minimum or raises it above the maximum. If a competitor sells below your minimum, the product appears under “Competitor below minimum” while your price stays within the safe range.

limit.title: Kaspi's limit: 250 changes
limit.text: Kaspi allows no more than 250 price changes per 30 minutes for each store. Kaspi Bot tracks the limit separately for every store, temporarily skips new changes when it is reached, and continues in later cycles after the limit refreshes.

productControl.title: Control each product separately
productControl.text: You can enable or disable automated pricing from an individual product card. Once disabled, Kaspi Bot stops changing that product's price in every connected store, while its current Kaspi price and saved price range remain unchanged.

filters.title: Categories and quick filters
filters.text: Filter the catalog to quickly find specific products and conditions that need attention.

all.title: All products
all.text: The full catalog from connected stores across every status.

active.title: Active pricing
active.text: The bot controls the price within the configured range.

disabled.title: Pricing disabled
disabled.text: The bot does not change the price, but the product settings remain saved.

draft.title: Setup required
draft.text: The product does not have a price range yet or pricing has not been enabled.

problem.title: Pricing without stores
problem.text: Pricing is enabled, but the product is not sold by any connected store.

belowMin.title: Competitor below minimum
belowMin.text: A competitor is below your minimum, so the bot does not follow their price down.

atMin.title: Price at minimum
atMin.text: The product has reached its minimum price in at least one store.

seo.title: Kaspi stock management | Kaspi Bot
seo.description: Kaspi Bot sends your configured product quantity to Kaspi whenever a price changes. Use one setting for every product, from 3 to 10,000 units.

stockManagement.subtitle: Stock levels without manual updates
stockManagement.title: Stock management on Kaspi
stockManagement.screenshotAlt: Product stock settings in Kaspi Bot — screen {number}

howItWorks.title: How stock levels are updated
howItWorks.text: Set the product quantity once, and Kaspi Bot sends it to Kaspi with every price change during automated pricing. You do not need to open Seller Cabinet and update the stock manually after each change.

oneSetting.title: One setting for every product
oneSetting.text: The selected quantity applies to every product managed by Price Bot. You can enter a whole number from 3 to 10,000 units, giving a large catalog one simple and predictable rule.

singleProduct.title: A different stock level for one product
singleProduct.text: If one product needs a different quantity, disable automated pricing for it and update the stock manually in Kaspi Seller Cabinet. The bot will then stop changing its price and sending the shared stock quantity for that product.

purchaseLimit.title: How stock affects an order
purchaseLimit.text: The configured stock limits how many units a customer can add to one order. Choose enough stock to avoid blocking orders with multiple identical items while still accounting for actual availability.

seo.title: Kaspi sales and order analytics | Kaspi Bot
seo.description: Analyze Kaspi orders by day, month, weekday, and hour. Find peak demand periods and your most popular products in Kaspi Bot.

analytics.subtitle: Understand demand through order data
analytics.title: Sales analytics for Kaspi
analytics.screenshotAlt: Kaspi sales analytics in Kaspi Bot — screen {number}

orders.title: Order trends for any period
orders.text: Select a date range and view the number of orders for each day. Kaspi Bot shows the total and the busiest day, making changes in demand visible without manual calculations.

months.title: Month-by-month comparison
months.text: The monthly chart reveals seasonality and identifies the month with the most orders. Use it to plan purchasing, stock levels, and promotional activity.

weekdays.title: Demand by weekday
weekdays.text: A separate chart groups orders by weekday and highlights when customers are most active. This makes it easier to distribute the team's workload and prepare for peak days.

hours.title: Orders by time of day
hours.text: Hourly statistics show how orders are distributed throughout the day and identify the busiest hour. You can see exactly when new orders are most likely to arrive.

popularProducts.title: Popular products
popularProducts.text: Kaspi Bot counts purchased units from completed orders over the selected period. The list helps identify products with consistent demand and supports better restocking decisions.

seo.title: Manage multiple Kaspi stores | Kaspi Bot
seo.description: Connect multiple Kaspi stores and manage products, automated pricing, and orders from one dashboard. Stores belonging to the same owner do not compete with each other.

multiStore.subtitle: Every store in one account
multiStore.title: Manage your Kaspi stores
multiStore.screenshotAlt: Kaspi store management in Kaspi Bot — screen {number}

onePanel.title: One dashboard for every store
onePanel.text: Connect multiple Kaspi stores and manage them from one account. Products, price changes, orders, and bot status are available without constantly switching between seller accounts.

sharedProducts.title: Shared product settings
sharedProducts.text: Matching products from different stores are combined in one catalog. Set the minimum and maximum price once, and the range applies to that product in every connected store where it is sold.

mainStore.title: Your stores do not undercut each other
mainStore.text: All your stores are excluded from the competitor list, so the bot follows external sellers only. You can select one main store, which receives a 1 tenge price advantage over your other stores during automated pricing.

storeControl.title: Control each store separately
storeControl.text: Pause automated pricing for one store while the other stores and Order Bot keep running. Fully disabling a store stops both bots from processing it but preserves its connection details.

connectionStatus.title: Clear connection status
connectionStatus.text: The store list shows whether a store is active, its access is being checked, or sign-in has failed. If the Kaspi session expires, authorization can be retried with the saved credentials.

seo.title: Sync products across Kaspi stores | Kaspi Bot
seo.description: Kaspi Bot adds missing products to every active Kaspi store. Start synchronization manually and track its progress and results.

productSync.subtitle: Every product in every active store
productSync.title: Kaspi product synchronization
productSync.screenshotAlt: Kaspi product synchronization in Kaspi Bot — screen {number}

purpose.title: Add missing products
purpose.text: If a product is sold in only some of your stores, Kaspi Bot finds where it is missing and adds it to every other active store. You do not need to find these gaps and connect each store manually.

requirements.title: Which products are synchronized
requirements.text: A product needs a valid maximum price before it can be added. Products already present are skipped, while products without the required setting are not added and appear as errors in the results.

safeRun.title: No conflict with price changes
safeRun.text: Synchronization and Price Bot share one exclusive queue and never update the catalog at the same time. Synchronization waits for an active pricing cycle to finish, and Price Bot resumes automatically after products have been added.

progress.title: Live progress and clear results
progress.text: The page shows how many products have been processed, added, or were already synchronized. Products with errors and failed add operations are reported separately.

manualControl.title: Runs only when you start it
manualControl.text: Synchronization starts manually from a dedicated button. A regular automated pricing cycle never adds missing products by itself, so you stay in control of when store catalogs change.

seo.title: New Kaspi orders in Telegram | Kaspi Bot
seo.description: Receive new Kaspi orders in Telegram, route them by pickup point, and process Express orders with your team without opening Seller Cabinet.

telegramOrders.subtitle: Orders without constantly opening Seller Cabinet
telegramOrders.title: New Kaspi orders in Telegram
telegramOrders.screenshotAlt: Kaspi orders in Telegram through Kaspi Bot — screen {number}

notifications.title: New orders delivered to Telegram
notifications.text: Order Bot regularly checks active stores and sends newly found orders to the configured Telegram channel. Employees receive notifications where they already communicate instead of repeatedly refreshing Kaspi Seller Cabinet.

orderDetails.title: Only the details needed to fulfill an order
orderDetails.text: The message includes the order number and contents, quantities, customer details, address, and delivery method. Prices, revenue, and store owner details are hidden, so employees see only what they need for their work.

channels.title: Channels for each pickup point
channels.text: Configure separate Telegram channels for Express and regular orders at every pickup point. Each message is routed to the correct team based on the store, pickup point, and delivery type.

teamwork.title: Process Express orders as a team
teamwork.text: An employee can take an Express order directly in Telegram, and their name appears in the message. Once the order is ready, the next button moves it to the courier search stage and updates the status for everyone.

reliability.title: No duplicate notifications
reliability.text: Kaspi Bot stores processed orders and does not resend the same order after a restart. Cancellation and courier assignment statuses update the existing message, keeping the channel current.

intro.p1: This Policy describes how the owner of the Kaspi Bot service (the “Operator”, “we”, or “us”) collects and processes information about users of the website, web application, and related bots (the “Service”). The Operator is an individual located in Almaty, Republic of Kazakhstan.

items.item1: telephone number and other information provided during registration or when contacting us;
items.item2: account and store data, including name, identifier, email address, and credentials for the Kaspi Seller Cabinet;
items.item3: information about products, prices, orders, pickup points, competitors, and automation settings;
items.item4: Telegram chat identifiers and notification settings;
items.item5: technical information, including IP address, cookies, browser and device details, dates and times of actions, error logs, and bot operation logs;
items.item6: other information voluntarily provided through the Service or support.

after.p1: We do not ask users to provide special categories of personal data. Users must not provide information that is not required for the operation of the Service.

before.p1: We process data to:

items.item1: create and maintain an account and respond to submitted requests;
items.item2: connect stores, synchronize products, and apply the configured price change rules;
items.item3: receive order information and send notifications to selected Telegram chats;
items.item4: maintain security, prevent abuse, diagnose errors, and restore operation;
items.item5: comply with legal requirements and protect the lawful rights of users and the Operator.

after.p1: Processing may include the collection, recording, organization, storage, updating, use, transfer, anonymization, blocking, and deletion of data, including by automated means.

before.p1: We receive data from the user, their browser, the connected Kaspi Seller Cabinet, and Telegram. To operate the Service, information may be transferred to hosting, database, and technical infrastructure providers, as well as to Kaspi and Telegram, only to the extent necessary.
before.p2: Third-party services operate under their own rules. Users are responsible for confirming that they are authorized to provide access to a store, orders, customer data, and Telegram chats. We do not sell personal data or transfer it to third parties for their independent advertising purposes.

before.p1: Certain infrastructure or integration providers may process data outside the Republic of Kazakhstan. Such transfers are made where the consent required by law or another lawful basis exists. Personal data databases are located and processed in accordance with the mandatory localization and protection requirements of the laws of the Republic of Kazakhstan.

Data is retained while the account exists and for as long as it is needed for the purposes listed above. After use of the Service ends, data is deleted or anonymized within a reasonable period, except for information that must be retained by law, to resolve disputes, maintain security, or verify operations. Backup copies may remain until their scheduled replacement.

We apply reasonable organizational and technical safeguards. However, no method of transmitting or storing data can guarantee absolute security. Users must use a strong password, restrict access to their account, and immediately report any suspected compromise.
Subject to the laws of the Republic of Kazakhstan, a user may:

items.item1: obtain information about the existence and contents of their personal data;
items.item2: request correction, blocking, or deletion where the data is inaccurate, unlawfully obtained, or no longer needed;
items.item3: withdraw consent where this does not conflict with the law or prevent the performance of an obligation;
items.item4: apply to the competent authority or a court to protect their rights.

after.p1: A request may be submitted through the contact form on the website. To protect data, we may ask for confirmation of identity and connection to the relevant account. Withdrawal of consent may make further provision of the Service impossible.

before.p1: The Service may use technically necessary cookies for authentication, language and theme preferences, security, and stable operation. Restricting cookies in the browser may make certain functions unavailable.

If a user provides data about customers, employees, or other individuals, the user guarantees that a lawful basis exists and must provide those individuals with the necessary information about the processing. A user must not connect another person's store or Telegram chat without the owner's permission.

We may update this Policy when the Service or applicable law changes. A new version takes effect on the date it is published on this page. We may additionally notify users through the Service of material changes.
